Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var inputJson = "{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{\"chunking\":{\"chunker_type\":\"text\",\"max_chars\":300,\"max_overlap\":40,\"trim\":true}}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extract(input, config);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).chunks());
    }
}
```
